    • getCategoriesPaged

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Category> getCategoriesPaged(int page, int size)
      Retrieve categories in a paginated and alphabetically ordered manner.

      This method fetches categories from the database ordered by their title in ascending order and returns a Page containing the requested page of categories. Pagination parameters allow clients to specify which page and how many items per page should be returned.

      Specified by:
      getCategoriesPaged in interface ICategoryService
      Parameters:
      page - the zero-based page index (0 = first page)
      size - the number of categories to return per page
      Returns:
      a Page of Category objects, sorted by title in ascending order

    • addCategories

      @Transactional public Set<Category> addCategories(Set<Category> categories)
      Create multiple categories in a single operation.

      This method allows bulk creation of categories by accepting a set of category objects. Each category will be persisted in the database, and the method returns a set of the saved categories including any generated IDs.

      If the provided set is null or empty, the method returns an empty set and logs a warning.

      Specified by:
      addCategories in interface ICategoryService
      Parameters:
      categories - the set of Category objects to be created
      Returns:
      a set of Category objects that were successfully saved

    • searchCategories

      public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<Category> searchCategories(String term, int page, int size)
      Searches for categories whose title or description contains the specified term, ignoring case sensitivity, and returns the results in a paginated format.

      This method is typically used to support search functionality in the client application, allowing users to find categories by keyword. The search is performed on both the title and description fields of the Category entity.

      Specified by:
      searchCategories in interface ICategoryService
      Parameters:
      term - the search keyword to look for within category titles or descriptions.
      page - the zero-based page index to retrieve.
      size - the number of categories to include per page.
      Returns:
      a Page of Category objects that match the search criteria.
